name: nav-buttons-collapse-into-a-menu
description: the nav group sheds buttons from the left instead of being clipped once the sidebar cannot hold it, and an overflow button offers what it hid. The row is fixed to the sidebar's own edges, so .sbnav's clientWidth IS the budget - a ResizeObserver on it re-runs sidebar-nav-row.js visibleNavButtons() with no message round trip, which is why a drag here shows up in the DOM within the same layout. The widths: the toggle plus three 22px buttons and their 2px gaps need 94, and the 16px overflow button is deliberately narrower than the button it stands in for, so each rung of the ladder frees real room (94 for three, 88 for two, 64 for one). The fixture stages 260, which is 164 of budget - three buttons. Dragging to 170 leaves 74, which is one button plus the menu. The overflow click below is a REAL OS click (cgevent) at the button's on-screen position, so it crosses AtriumClientView::NonClientHitTest before the page sees it - atrium_nav_carve_decision.cc runs the same ladder off the same constants, and sidebar-nav-row-test.mjs reads them back out of the .cc to catch a drift.

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.sbnav'); const more = row && row.querySelector('.sbmore'); if (!more) { return 'no menu button'; } return Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().right - more.getBoundingClientRect().right); })()
actions.note: the collapsed group still hugs the row's right edge, so nothing was clipped - the anchor moved with it

THE MEASUREMENT: the overflow button's centre at the dragged-to width 170. x = 170 - kNavGroupRightInset(10) - half a 16px button(8) = 152. y = window top on screen(30) + .sbnav's top inset(9) + half the button height(11) = 50, click coordinates are screen-absolute. A real OS click, so it must clear NonClientHitTest's carve before the page ever sees it.

actions.expression: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('.sbnav .navmenu'); if (!menu) { return 'no menu'; } return menu.querySelectorAll('.ctxitem').length ? [...menu.querySelectorAll('.ctxitem')].map((b) => b.textContent).join('|') : 'empty'; })()
